## Objective
- Finish Phase 1 of the Aevryn chat interface (stores, real ChatComposer, ChatMessage/SystemMessage wrappers, full Realtime hook — all done) and now fix three UI bugs the user reported: Header.tsx thread dropdown not updating instantly, Header input field not visible, and sidebar thread names not truncated.

## Important Details
- Monorepo `D:\github-desktop\aevryn`; packageManager `bun@1.3.9`; root workspaces `apps/*` + `packages/*` with `catalog` deps; web runs on `next dev --port 3001`.
- AI SDK: `ai@7.0.93`, `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.102` (useChat lives in `@ai-sdk/react`; `FileUIPart`, `DefaultChatTransport`, `UIMessage` types come from `ai`).
- AI SDK v7 `useChat` has NO `api`/`body` option — must pass `transport: new DefaultChatTransport({ api, body })`.
- Request body merge: `{ ...transport.body, ...options.body, id, messages, trigger, messageId }`.
- `bun add ... --filter web` fails ("Package web@0.0.2 has a dependency loop") — use `cd apps/web && bun add` instead.
- Supabase realtime channels: `thread:{threadId}` (chat_messages, run_activities, approval_requests) + `user:{userId}` (notifications). Supabase `.on()` does NOT accept generic type args — annotate payload params instead.
- `@aevryn/ui` exports map `./components/*` → `./src/components/*.tsx`, so `@aevryn/ui/components/ui/chat-message` and `@aevryn/ui/components/ui/system-message` resolve.
- User decisions: KEEP attachments UI (Plus button disabled only, FileThumbnail chips + drag-drop intact); KEEP queue as client-side message store, not real queue (stack cards while streaming, auto-dispatch head on idle). Suggestions stay.

## Work State
### Completed
- CHAT.md read; Phase 1 scope: stores, ChatComposer, ChatMessage, SystemMessage, Realtime wiring.
- Stores exist: `apps/web/src/stores/{thread,composer,sidebar,notifications,ui,auth}-store.ts` + `index.ts`.

  - `useChat({ id: threadId??, transport: new DefaultChatTransport({ api: "/api/chat", body: { threadId } }) })`; `isStreaming = status==="submitted"||"streaming"`; `onStop` → `stop()`.

  - Attachments: leftSlot Plus button `disabled`, files→data-URL `FileUIPart[]` passed to `sendMessage`; token slider steps 1–5 → `maxOutputTokens` via per-send body.
- Updated `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: `chatBodySchema` now has optional `message` AND optional `messages` (loose UIMessage history); `promptFromMessages()` extracts last user text + file parts; falls back to legacy `message`; still validates non-empty message.
- `apps/web/src/app/workspace/[workspaceId]/[threadId]/page.tsx`: `<ChatComposer threadId={threadId} />`.
- Created `apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatMessage.tsx`: text parts joined as bubble body; `tool-*` parts → muted "Running: X"; empty messages return null.
- Created `apps/web/src/components/chat/SystemMessage.tsx`: wrapper over packages/ui SystemMessage, default `mb-[40px]` via `spaced` prop.

- Typecheck: clean on all touched files (composer, route, page, hook, ChatMessage, SystemMessage).

### Active
- Investigating 3 reported bugs; just read `apps/web/src/components/workspace/Header.tsx` (truncated read at ~line 70) and `packages/ui/src/components/ui/input-group.tsx`.

- Pre-existing (NOT introduced by this work) typecheck errors: `packages/ui/src/components/ui/input-message.tsx` (lines ~682 `'next' possibly undefined`, 733 `QueuedMessage | undefined`, 796/842/859 string undefined), `dropdown-search.tsx:283`, `dropdown.tsx:164`, `workflow-sections.tsx` unused vars, `app-sidebar.tsx:97` unused var, `../env/src/server.ts` / `web.ts` "Cannot find name 'process'", `apps/web/src/app/api/thread-status/route.ts` (cannot find module `drizzle-orm`; `NextResponse` not found).
